description.fun: A goldfish made of fire, with two pairs of curved jade beads for eyes. The beads are its true form, brought to life by the envy of people who fought wars over them. Its flames burn at over 3,000°C, hot enough to melt rock and sand into a sea of lava that it swims through without a care. Green beads born of envy may nod to Shakespeare's 'green-eyed monster'.
description.guide: A Dark and Fire-type Legendary Pokémon from Pokémon Scarlet and Violet, one of the four treasures of ruin. Its true form is the curved jade beads that make up its eyes, and it controls intensely hot flames. It is known as the Beads of Ruin.
description.tagline: A fire goldfish with jade beads for eyes, born of envy
